title: 50 Essentials on Science Communication
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: Science communication skills are important in both academia and the industry. This book supports interactions between academia and the public by training early career researchers in communicating their research findings effectively to a non-specialist audience. The guide provides theoretical knowledge on science communication across disciplines, and it offers practical advice on how to apply this knowledge in a number of different contexts.
